key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
Subsequent floods caused 23 more deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh
evidence_snippets: On 12 October 2013, Cyclone Phailin crossed the coast south of Brahmapur, Odisha.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
Over 13 lakh evacuated; 21 cyclone deaths, plus 23 in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh from subsequent floods.
missing_information: Exact list of affected districts not provided
Specific flood dates beyond landfall not specified
